This module implements an advanced plugin system for Nim, allowing developers to create and manage plugins that can extend the functionality of their applications in a modular and scalable way.

Use -d:pluginkit_debug to enable debug output for the generated plugin code.

Imports

pluginkit/nanoid, pluginkit/readers

Types

NanoID = string
A type representing a unique identifier for plugins, generated using the NanoID algorithm. 
Plugin {.inheritable.} = ref object
  runId*: Option[NanoID] ## A persistent unique identifier for the plugin, generated using NanoID
                         ## at the time of the plugin's installation. This ID is stored in the database and
                         ## is used to track the plugin across application restarts, allowing for consistent
                         ## identification of the plugin
  staticTemplates*: TableRef[string, string]
  registerRoutes*: JsonNode
The structure representing a plugin.

PluginDatabaseSchemas = JsonNode
Custom schemas defined by the plugin for its database models 
PluginManager = ref object
  callbacks*: PluginManagerCallbacks ## The callbacks registered with the PluginManager, allowing it to notify plugins
                                     ## of lifecycle events such as loading, unloading, and errors.
The PluginManager is responsible for managing the lifecycle of plugins, including loading, unloading, and executing plugins. It maintains a registry of available plugins and their statuses. 
PluginManagerCallbacks = object
  onLoad*: proc (plugin: Plugin) ## Callback that is called when a plugin is successfully loaded.
  onUnload*: proc (plugin: Plugin) ## Callback that is called when a plugin is successfully unloaded.
  onError*: proc (plugin: Plugin; error: string) ## Callback that is called when an error occurs during plugin loading or unloading.
The PluginManagerCallbacks structure defines the callbacks that can be registered with the PluginManager. These callbacks allow plugins to respond to various events in the plugin lifecycle, such as when a plugin is loaded, unloaded, or when an error occurs. 
PluginManagerError = object of CatchableError
PluginManifest {.bycopy.} = object
  abiVersion*: uint32 ## The ABI version of the plugin, used to ensure compatibility between
                      ## the plugin and the plugin system. This allows the plugin manager
                      ## to check if a plugin is compatible with the current version of the
                      ## plugin system before loading it.
  name*, author*, description*, license*, url*: cstring ## Metadata fields for the plugin, including its name, author, description,
                                                        ## license, and URL. These fields provide information about the plugin and
                                                        ## can be used for display purposes in a plugin manager or marketplace.
  version*: cstring          ## The version of the plugin, following semantic versioning.
  nimVersion*: cstring       ## The version of Nim required for the plugin to be compatible with the plugin system.
  permissions*: PluginPermissionMask ## A bitmask representing the permissions that the plugin requests. This allows
                                     ## for efficient storage and checking of multiple permissions for a plugin.
The structure representing the manifest of a plugin, containing metadata about the plugin such as its name, author, description, license, URL, version, and the permissions it requests. 
PluginPermission = enum
  reqNil, reqDBFullAccess, reqDBReadOnly, reqDBWriteOnly, reqEvents, reqRoutes,
  reqAccessConfig, reqAccessSessions
Enumeration representing permissions that a plugin can request. 
PluginPermissionMask = uint64
A type representing a bitmask of plugin permissions, allowing for efficient storage and checking of multiple permissions for a plugin. 
PluginStatus = enum
  pluginStatusUnload, pluginStatusLoaded, pluginStatusActive,
  pluginStatusInvalid
Representation of the status of a plugin, indicating whether it is active or inactive 
PluginSystemVersion = object
The structure representing the version of the plugin system and the minimum required version for a plugin to be compatible with.

  pluginTypeAuthentication, pluginTypeDatabase, pluginTypeAnalytics,
  pluginTypePayment, pluginTypeNotification, pluginTypeOther

Resolves the plugin_event_load_commands entrypoint exported by a plugin and returns its CLI command manifest as a JsonNode array, or none(JsonNode) when the plugin does not expose any commands.
